description: Request shape for counting the rows a file download batch export would produce.

hogql_query.description: HogQL SELECT query whose results are exported. This model is in closed beta and is enabled per team; when it is not enabled, the request fails with a permission error that names HogQL batch exports. Contact PostHog support to request access. Placeholders are not currently supported, and every column in the SELECT clause must be a field or have an alias. It is recommended to limit the query with a WHERE clause, for example bounding timestamp on the events table, both to avoid exporting more rows than expected and because user queries run under stricter resource limits than the other models.

model.description:
Model to count rows for. Only 'hogql' is supported.

* `hogql` - hogql
